name: Miko Shibari 2
source:
One day, Hideo's uncle tells him to come to his shrine. He visits there and meets Kanna and Yuna, his childhood friends. But he is surprised to hear the reason for his visit...! His uncle suddenly tells him to have Kinbaku sex (a style of sex with ropes) with Kanna and Yuna. According to his uncle, they will have a good crop if he has sex with a sacred rope. He is selected as a partner of Kanna and Yuna because he is the one whom they first fell in love....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090809110034/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012877]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
有一天，秀夫的叔叔叫他去神社。他拜访了那里并遇到了他儿时的朋友卡娜和尤娜。但听到他来访的原因，他感到很惊讶……！他的叔叔突然告诉他要与神无和尤娜进行金爆性爱（一种用绳子做爱的方式）。据他叔叔说，如果他与一根神圣的绳子发生性关系，他们就会有好收成。他被选为神无和尤娜的伴侣，因为他是他们第一个坠入爱河的人……
